title: Max loss shown as Unlimited for a naked short put or a long future (row 13 gap G-13-1, owner question)
reference_behaviour: A sold put, a bought future and similar shapes show max loss as Unlimited, even though an index cannot fall below zero.
ours: SPEC CHANGE: scenario-calculations section 3 Tails (ADR-045, locked) and REQ-033 AC-6 give the finite lower-tail loss, about Rs 14.7 lakh on one NIFTY 22,800 PE; only the upper tail reads Unlimited.
